description: rangeStrategy: always bump dependencies, even when the new version is already in the range.
rebaseWhen: rebase only on conflicts, to save unnecessary workflow runs.

gitIgnoredAuthors: Biome Migrate commits the migrated biome.jsonc to Renovate branches as github-actions. Without this, Renovate would see the branch as modified by someone else and stop rebasing and updating it.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes must not be delayed by minimumReleaseAge.

description: mise.lock pins a checksum and a URL per tool per platform, but a local `mise install` re-locks only the platform it runs on and silently leaves the others stale.

Lock file maintenance runs plain `mise lock`, which refreshes every tool on every platform already in the file, and `uv lock --upgrade`, which moves the dependencies of uv.lock, as Pyjoyment, to their latest releases.
Defaults are disabled and weekly, hence the explicit settings.

packageRules.description: requires-python of pyproject.toml is the lowest Python that the distribution supports, on purpose, not the Python of mise.toml, so rangeStrategy bump must not raise it.

customManagers.description: Renovate hints in a comment after the version.
